correctness.rationale: Reconstructed graph GP(10,3) with 20 vertices, 30 distinct edges, degree three and closed neighborhoods of cardinality four, including the exact 20-bit face predicate N[x] not contained in sigma. Separate local checker independently tested all 2^20 masks without relying on the source recurrence, obtaining 434220 nonempty faces and the exact 14-entry f-vector. Reconstructed the deterministic pivot matching on all faces (217103 pairs) and the entire oriented Hasse graph (3663080 incidences); exact indegree topological sort visited all 434220 nodes, proving true acyclicity, and critical cells were exactly one dimension-zero and 13 dimension-nine faces. Acyclic-matching theorem therefore gives a CW with a single point and 13 9-cells, so an integral wedge of 13 S9 (no possible nontrivial attaching maps to a point). Independently computed all ten signed simplicial Lefschetz traces by fixed orbit unions and per-orbit permutation parity, yielding (13,-1,3,-1,3,-11,3,-1,3,-1). With H0=1 and reduced H9 in odd dimension, tr_H9=1-L. Rational C10 Ramanujan-character decomposition indeed has trivial multiplicity 1, sign 4, faithful cyclotomic10 2, order-five cyclotomic 0. Explicit 20-vertex isomorphism to bipartite Petersen double cover separately checked. All asserted homology over Z follows from homotopy, not a finite-field rank alone.
residual_risks: This proves only D(GP(10,3)) for the explicitly defined closed-neighborhood-complement complex and the designated order-ten rotation; not arbitrary generalized Petersen graphs or full automorphism group.
C10 representation decomposition is over Q, not a classification of integral Z[C10]-lattices.
The exhaustive certificate was independently replayed in local Python; no external formal/Lean/expert attestation.

value.rationale: The Desargues graph is a distinguished highly symmetric cubic Levi graph of the ten-point Desargues configuration and canonical bipartite cover of Petersen; its dominance complex is a standard natural invariant with few exact homotopy computations. An exact integral homotopy type of thirteen S9s and the nontrivial full rational rotation character are two substantive, potentially reusable invariants, not a routine reformulation of graph parameters or a known table. The all-face, full oriented-Hasse certificate gives a meaningful complete classification for this canonical object. The cyclic trace additionally reveals sign and faithful cyclotomic constituents invisible to the sphere count. A uniform family theorem or paper-sized application is not needed for this motivated exact case.
residual_risks: The result is a single canonical graph, with no all-GP(n,k) extension and no integral C10-module splitting.
Usefulness is as a complete benchmark/equivariant exact graph invariant; no particular downstream theorem is asserted.

limitations: Single graph GP(10,3), not an infinite graph-family theorem.
Rational cyclic character only, not integral module decomposition or full automorphism group action.
Originality is best-of-knowledge, with unindexed/potentially equivalent computations a residual risk.
